source: Complete forward and reverse keyboard traversal with focused-element geometry and element-from-point sampling
evidence: EVID-FULL-SUITE-SUMMARY: a 23-stop forward cycle and 22-stop reverse traversal used real Tab and Shift+Tab events on /node/2/edit.
EVID-FULL-SUITE-RESOLUTIONS: the Article and Home breadcrumb links received focus at y=33 while the fixed Navigation top bar was the top element over all 25 sampled points for each link.
Each focused breadcrumb had a visible sample fraction of 0 even though the focus style was present underneath the overlay.
reproduction_steps: Enable Navigation, authenticate as an author, and open /node/2/edit at a desktop viewport.
Use Tab until the focus sequence returns to its first control.
Use Shift+Tab to traverse backward to the Article and Home breadcrumb links.
Observe that the fixed top bar completely covers each focused link.
expected_behavior: When a user interface component receives keyboard focus, it is not entirely hidden by author-created content.
actual_behavior: The fixed Navigation top bar completely covers both focused breadcrumb links during reverse keyboard traversal.
